notes.title: Small Update with new Keybinds, Attributes, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
BUG FIXES
[*] KEYBINDS: 'M' once again properly toggling the map
[*] ATTRIBUTES: Animal attributes now mostly displaying correctly

GAMEPLAY CHANGES
[*] KEYBINDS: Keys added for Family and Inventory menus (see controls)
[*] KEYBINDS: Vocalizations now triggered by the number keys (1,2,3,etc)
[*] BREEDING: Informational popup will inform player of breeding issues
[*] MAP: Mates now identified by name on map

KNOWN ISSUES
[*] FLYING: AI still needs improvement for mates / enemy flying
[/list]

notes.title: The Raven enters The WILDS....
notes.content:
[list]
[*] NEW ANIMAL: The Raven is now available on the animal roster
[*] NEW FEATURE: Sleeping added at dens (passes in game time)
[*] CONTROL CHANGE: Sprinting is now a toggleable action (quick press to trot)
[*] IMPROVED: Camera movement / control smoothing and responsiveness
[*] IMPROVED: Interaction system reworked
[*] IMPROVED: Edible foods now properly respawn
[*] IMPROVED: Various other bug fixes / changes / improvements
[/list]
